text:
maria: Morning — nightly perf alert for the smoke suite, P95 up ~22% vs baseline. alert id nb-18765. https://dash.redwood.ai/perf/nb-18765 :eyes:

jake: I pulled the CI trace — looks like the small-batch codepath spiking. trace saved at /nfs/bench/traces/nb-18765/trace.json

sophia-sre: FYI tagging oncall — @ryan-oncall can you grab a flamegraph and check GPU driver/runtime versions? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan-oncall: On it. pulling job logs now. what command should I run to reproduce quickly?

maria: Local repro (CI image/GPU):
```bash
./run_bench --suite=smoke --model=redwood-small --batch=4 --seq=512 --seed=42 --collect-trace=flame
```

jake: Also run with `--batch=1` and `--batch=8` to compare scaling. If softmax/kernels blow up it's obvious.

ryan-oncall: Ran batch=4 locally: P95 ~780ms (baseline ~630ms). Uploaded flamegraph: https://internal.redwood/trace/18765/flame.svg — main hotspot in attention_softmax_kernel (lines around aten::softmax)

sophia-sre: Any infra changes around Mar 11? kernel or driver rollouts?

maria: Perf CI metadata shows nodes moved from `cuda-driver 535.86` -> `536.18` during nightly on Mar 11. Could be correlated.

jake: We should bisect driver vs runtime change. I can spin a runner pinned to 535.86 to test.

ryan-oncall: Started a quick bisect job that toggles driver version on a minimal matrix: ci-bisect/18765. ETA ~30m.

ci-bot: bisect job started: ci-bisect/18765 (8 containers). logs: https://ci.redwood/job/ci-bisect/18765

maria: Good call. If bisect implicates driver, plan is to roll canary nodes back to 535.86 and validate smoke suite for a few cycles.

jake: Also check cudnn/LD paths — sometimes cuda driver bump changes microkernel selection. `nvidia-smi` + `ldd` on cu*.

ryan-oncall: Bisect finished — result: matches baseline on 535.86, regression on 536.18. Driver bump is the likely cause. Initiating canary rollback to 535.86 in us-west-2 now.

sophia-sre: Thanks — will keep watch on dashboards and alert thresholds. :eyes:

maria: I've created ticket RW-9876 with notes, traces, and rollout plan. Assigning follow-ups: pin drivers in CI images, add driver check to smoke CI, and incident postmortem. :white_check_mark:

jake: Nice work. If rollback stabilizes, we can coordinate a vendor repro with NVIDIA and test newer driver in a controlled cluster. :shipit:
